newsitem.title: USA: WMX Chairman forgoes 97 salary, took stock options.
newsitem.headline: WMX Chairman forgoes 97 salary, took stock options.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc Chairman and acting Chief Executive Dean Buntrock will get no regular salary this year, according to the 1997 WMX proxy statement.
He will get 150,000 stock options at $33 per share, the company said.
WMX shares were off 3/8 to 31 late Thursday.

Buntrock took a pay cut in 1996, when his total compensation was $1.3 million plus 176,656 stock options, compared to $3.6 million in pay, stock-based bonus plus 205,505 stock options in 1995, the company reported.
